semantics.secondary: Descriptive mean/sampleSD/min/max/sign counts across five paired optimizer seeds; no event CI was generated.
semantics.primary: Original 16-family approximate95% simultaneous event-bootstrap intervals, fixed fitted models, C/D separate.
semantics.seed: Post-hoc seed sensitivity. LOO is not a CI. Optional n=5 t intervals are nominal, unadjusted and separate from event bootstrap.
semantics.historical: Earlier two-input Hidden is not the new nominal-five-input Hidden5. H is an erroneous-center control.
semantics.repeated_models: New/earlier Exact-momentum Small10/100 states overlap; duplicated contrasts are not independent evidence.
